method: Same packaged 240x240 wetland fixture, four mercs, twelve guards, eight civilians; 5 s warm-up then 20 s/40 fixed ticks. ABBAAB order; DPR 1; GPU timer disabled; no concurrent test/build commands. CPU/RAF callbacks are not a displayed-FPS measurement. Full-turn comparison runs to the next player phase. Saves use frozen gameplay clock and settled presentation for image comparisons.
